✒️ OneStroke

A set of dots connected by lines is shown — draw over every line exactly once without lifting your pen or retracing. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Start from one dot and draw a line through every edge exactly once.
  2. You cannot lift your pen or draw over the same line twice.
  3. If a dot has an odd number of edges, it must be a start or end point.
  4. A shape is drawable in one stroke if it has 0 or 2 odd-degree vertices.
  5. Find the correct starting point — not every start works.
